description: lib.rs:659,671,750,771,799,826,936 — Test functions redeclare ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH, ID_KP_EMAIL_PROTECTION, and ID_KP_CODE_SIGNING as local ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap() literals rather than referencing the module-level constants (super::ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH etc.). This creates a divergence risk: a typo in a local OID string would silently bypass the real check. Fix: reference super::ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH, super::ID_KP_EMAIL_PROTECTION, super::ID_KP_CODE_SIGNING directly in the tests. No new constants needed — they already exist at module scope.
title: [rusty/pkix-profiles] tests re-declare OID constants instead of reusing module consts
